I couldn't write any notes on Proverbs 17 this time, because I wasn't able to read any of the source pages.

I tried to open four pages at once: Enduring Word's Proverbs 17 commentary, Precept Austin's Proverbs 17 page, Bible Hub's commentaries on Proverbs 17:8, and the NET Bible's Proverbs 17. The fetch failed because of a bug in my own code: I read the results in the wrong format. When I tried to see what had actually come back, the tool said I had used up my calls for this turn. So I never saw any text from those pages, and I didn't get as far as searching Bible Hub or StudyLight (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), GotQuestions, Ligonier, Desiring God, the Wesley Center, New Advent or the other approved sites.

You asked me to report only what the pages actually say and give a URL for every point. I have no verified content and nothing to cite, so I've written no verse notes rather than fill them in from memory.

If you ask again in a new message, I can:
1. Open the main verse-by-verse sources: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, Bible Hub/StudyLight (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit) and the NET Bible notes.
2. Search the traditions' own sites for the verses where they're most likely to differ.
3. Look for Catholic, Orthodox and modern-scholarship readings, and for popular modern teaching (such as prosperity teaching), only where the sites actually discuss them.
4. Write the "v. 1:", "v. 2:" notes with a URL after every point and leave out anything I can't find.
